coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first and was directly retrievable; the newest notices listed were dated 2026-09-25, with no new termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or comparable access-risk notice in the hourly window. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were completed across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, ambulance/EMS, air-medical, restoration/reopening, U.S. territories, and official/state notice classes. No qualifying new access change was identified. Excluded/duplicate examples included NHC Hillsboro Reproductive Health Clinic's previously announced 2026-09-30 closure; the Saint Charles, Missouri ambulance handoff that preserves emergency transport coverage; Sentara Williamsburg's new Level III trauma capability (expansion, not restoration of a previously lost essential service); Watsonville Community Hospital NICU closure that dates to July; and California Patterson rural-emergency legislation veto coverage, which did not itself close or suspend an existing service.
